instruction: Put the red toy block on the orange tray.

attempts.code:
go_home()
wait(20)

obs = observe()
red_block = obs["objects"]["red_block"]
orange_tray = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]

# Check if orange_tray is occupied
occupied = False
for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():
    if obj_name == "red_block":
        continue
    obj_center = obj["center"]
    if (abs(obj_center[0] - orange_tray["center"][0]) < orange_tray["half_size"][0] +
        obj["footprint_long"] / 2 and
        abs(obj_center[1] - orange_tray["center"][1]) < orange_tray["half_size"][1] +
        obj["footprint_short"] / 2):
        # Object is on the tray; move it to purple_box if possible
        purple_box = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]
        # Check if purple_box is available (not occupied)
        purple_box_occupied = False
        for o_name, o in obs["objects"].items():
            if o_name == "red_block":
                continue
            o_center = o["center"]
            if (abs(o_center[0] - purple_box["center"][0]) < purple_box["half_size"][0] +
                o["footprint_long"] / 2 and
                abs(o_center[1] - purple_box["center"][1]) < purple_box["half_size"][1] +
                o["footprint_short"] / 2):
                purple_box_occupied = True
                break
        if not purple_box_occupied:
            # Move object to purple_box
            obj_center = obj["center"]
            move_to(obj_center[0], obj_center[1], obs["table_z"] + 0.1, yaw=None)
            move_to(obj_center[0], obj_center[1], obs["table_z"] + 0.01, yaw=None)
            open_gripper()
            move_to(obj_center[0], obj_center[1], obs["table_z"] + 0.1, yaw=None)
            move_to(purple_box["center"][0], purple_box["center"][1], obs["table_z"] + 0.1, yaw=None)
            move_to(purple_box["center"][0], purple_box["center"][1], obs["table_z"] + 0.01, yaw=None)
            close_gripper()
            move_to(purple_box["center"][0], purple_box["center"][1], obs["table_z"] + 0.1, yaw=None)
        else:
            # Cannot clear tray; abort
            raise RuntimeError("Cannot clear orange_tray: purple_box is occupied")
        occupied = True
        break

# Now pick up red_block
move_to(red_block["center"][0], red_block["center"][1], obs["table_z"] + 0.1, yaw=None)
move_to(red_block["center"][0], red_block["center"][1], red_block["top_z"] + 0.01, yaw=None)
open_gripper()

close_gripper()
wait(20)
if not obs["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grip red_block")

# Lift high enough to clear obstacles

# Move to orange_tray and place
move_to(orange_tray["center"][0], orange_tray["center"][1], obs["table_z"] + 0.3, yaw=None)
move_to(orange_tray["center"][0], orange_tray["center"][1], orange_tray["center"][2] + 0.01, yaw=None)
